verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly shows that a non-cloud Bitbucket Server/Data Center edition exists: it is named with a Data Center license and as a source for migration to Bitbucket Cloud. Nothing documents installing, configuring, upgrading, or maintaining a self-hosted instance, and the framing pushes users toward Cloud. Private runners are adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a self-managed deployment option, install/configuration guides, upgrade and maintenance procedures, independent or hands-on corroboration of running it on your own infrastructure.
